Generated bởi generate-phase4-report.sh song song với Phase4-report.md (tiếng Việt ≤15 dòng). Non-breaking: downstream skills VẪN có thể đọc lanes/QD*/signals.json trực tiếp (backward compatible). Writer chuyển từ wf-fix-execute claim sang scripts/wf-fix-bugs/verify-execute-outputs.sh derive-from-fix-log (cleaner — fix-log.json là structured SSOT của per-fix data). Phase 7 cqg1-numeric.sh ưu tiên đọc fix-execution-result.json structured (fast-path JSON v2), fallback regex Markdown nếu missing (zero regression). actual_source field trong output JSON cho debug. (2) Phase 2 templates bump v2: code-inventory + doc-inventory + scope-analysis bổ sung _schema_notes định nghĩa files[]/docs[]/languages[] item shape, by_module/by_language map schema, dependency_level enum {none,light,moderate,heavy}, interface_type enum, consumer hints (Phase 3 ISG, Phase 4 lane agents). (3) Phase 3 templates bump v2: work-plan.json align template với route-and-write.sh script output (dimensions_applied[], playwright{enabled,mode,order,devices}, agent_count_estimate, workload_count, total_estimated_issues). dimension-plan.json align (dimensions[] item schema: id/lane_skill/agent_type/probe_count/output_dir/needs_playwright/playwright_priority). route-and-write.sh dimension-plan emission thêm $schema field cho consumer validation. (4) Phase 5 mới: coverage-report.json schema coverage-report-v1 song hành coverage-report.md (machine-readable cho Phase 7 + wf-prepare-deployment opt-in consumer). Writer: generate-phase5-reports.sh §5.11b. Schema: dimensions[] per-dim, distribution.by_severity{critical,high,medium,low,info}{count,pct}, totals{dims_covered, dims_total, dims_skipped, probe_success_rate, total_signals, total_issues}. (5) issue-registry.json bump v2: bổ sung _schema_notes định nghĩa issues[] item required fields (id, fingerprint, dimension_id, probe_id, severity, fixability, title, location, source) + optional (req_ids, feat_ids, cdg_flags, recommended_action, evidence_paths). Consumer hints cho wf-fix-triage/wf-fix-execute/CQG-2. (6) docs-sync-report.json bump v2: thêm files_synced field (POST-GATE T3 check), docs_updated[] item schema (path, phase, change_type, req_ids_added/removed, summary), impl_status_changes[] item (req_id, feat_id, old_status, new_status, reason, timestamp — CORE-008 không downgrade done), audit_chain (source, checksum_before/after, applied_by, atomic_write — CORE-006). (1) Created procedures/_optimization-playbook.md document hóa 10 kỹ thuật canonical (T1 Parallel Wave Dispatchers, T2 Fast-Path Bash Bypass, T3 Caching Idempotent Validations, T4 Heavy Inline Bash Extraction, T5 Shared Protocols Split, T6 Phase Lazy-Load Split, T7 Group Banners + Flow Map, T8 Smoke Test Routing, T9 Cross-Platform Defensive Scripts, T10 Versioned Schemas with Audit Trail) — apply order: T9+T10 foundation, T4 extract, T1 parallelize, T2 bypass, T3 cache, T7 banners, T6 split, T5 shared refs, T8 verify. Includes when-to-apply + when-NOT-to-apply rules + Phase 1 metrics achieved (-87% peak context per phase). (2) Created 2 shared helper scripts reusable cross-phase (2-7): phase-trace-start.sh (~50 dòng — generic START event với atomic write + optional metadata merge), phase-finalize.sh (~85 dòng — generic TRACE COMPLETE + atomic fix-status.phaseN update + extra fields merge). Replace ~30 dòng inline bash per phase = -180 dòng net khi full rollout. (3) Phase 2 migrated to shared scripts: Step 2.2 TRACE START (was 12 dòng → 1 line script call), Step 2.5 TRACE COMPLETE + Update fix-status (was 22 dòng → 3-line script call). (4) Documented multi-session rollout plan plans/wf-fix-bugs-phase-rollout-v10.15/ROLLOUT-PLAN.md với per-phase action plan (Phase 3-7), priority ranking (Phase 4/5/7 HIGH, Phase 6 MEDIUM, Phase 3 borderline), session breakdown (Session 2-5), acceptance criteria, critical preservation rules (CDG INLINE, Agent spawn orchestrator-side, UI tools KHÔNG extract). v10.14.0 (2026-05-16): Phase 1 lazy-load split — phase1-init.md (1106 dòng monolithic, ~9K tokens) tách thành 80-dòng index router + 8 group sub-files (A-bootstrap ~138, B-wave1 ~105, C-decision ~96, D-session-setup ~159, E-isg ~85, F-wave4 ~103, G-finalize ~93, POST-GATE ~74) trong procedures/phase1-init/. Orchestrator workflow: đọc index (~1K tokens) rồi load TỪNG group file ON-DEMAND khi tới execution (500-1200 tokens per group). Mỗi group file có Input/Output contract section + Next Group pointer cuối file để routing rõ ràng. 4 helper scripts mới extract heavy inline bash: phase1-parse-flags.sh (Step 1.2, ~110 dòng standalone), phase1-auto-resolve.sh (Step 1.8, ~95 dòng), phase1-create-session.sh (Step 1.10, ~80 dòng), phase1-trace-start.sh (Step 1.17, ~70 dòng). Per-group context ~88% nhỏ hơn vs monolithic. Smoke test phase1-routing-smoke-test.sh (42 checks: index integrity + group files existence + routing chain unbroken + Input/Output contracts + helper scripts ready) PASS 42/42. Runtime correctness ensured by: (1) index file Group Routing Table với `Khi đọc` column rõ ràng, (2) mỗi group file declare Entry/Exit condition + Next pointer, (3) Input/Output contract sections để orchestrator track state passing giữa groups, (4) shared protocols lazy-load per-group declared at header. Backward compat: phase1-init.md vẫn entry point từ SKILL.md routing, semantic giữ nguyên. v10.13.0 (2026-05-16): Shared protocols split — _shared.md (1227 dòng monolithic, ~10K tokens) tách thành 21 file riêng trong procedures/_shared/ (lazy-load per use-site). Mỗi phase chỉ load 1-4 section cần thiết → giảm context per phase invocation 80-95%. Phase 1: 10K → ~1K shared context (-91%). Phase 2: -97%. Phase 3: -96%. Phase 4: -68%. Phase 5: -86%. Phase 6: -88%. Phase 7: -92%. 4 sections slim (§1 State Vars, §4 Error Handling, §10 Template Usage, §17 Session Isolation) thành pointer 1-line đến rules/00-core.md (CORE-001/CORE-034/CORE-031/CORE-030/CORE-035). Backward compat: _shared.md chuyển từ 1227 dòng monolithic thành ~50 dòng redirect file với quick-index mapping §NN → _shared/NN-name.md. 7 phase files + resume-status.md update reference từ `_shared.md §NN` sang `_shared/NN-name.md`. Phase headers bỏ preemptive `Shared: Đọc procedures/_shared.md...` (orchestrator load lazily on-demand). Tạo _shared/README.md (index, ~80 dòng) với load profile per-phase + slim notes + migration guide. v10.12.0 (2026-05-16): Phase 1 parallel optimization wave — 4 helpers mới (~750 dòng tổng) + procedure refactor. (1) Wave 1 Parallel Discovery: Steps 1.5 (CI PRE-GATE) + 1.6 (Registry+Source+LEGACY) + 1.9 (Sub-skill paths) gộp thành 1 bash tool call qua scripts/wf-fix-bugs/phase1-wave1-dispatch.sh — 3 workers chạy parallel internal qua bash & wait, emit env-style stdout cho orchestrator eval. (2) Wave 4 Parallel State Init: Steps 1.15 (init-session-state 4 files) + 1.16 (init-bug-dashboard) gộp thành 1 bash tool call qua scripts/wf-fix-bugs/phase1-init-bundle.sh — 2 workers parallel, emit aggregated status JSON {state,dashboard,duration_ms}. Exit code aggregation: W1 only=1 CRITICAL, W2 only=2 NON-BLOCKING, both=3 CRITICAL. (3) Step 1.14 ISG fast-path: scripts/wf-fix-bugs/phase1-isg-fastpath.sh — bash hardcoded lookup cho profile chuẩn (quick/standard/deep/exhaustive ~5ms) bypass Python ISG spawn (~200-500ms cold start). Hardcoded dims ĐỒNG BỘ với isg_recommender.PROFILE_DIMENSIONS. Escape hatch MCV3_FIX_BUGS_FORCE_ISG=1 cho legacy/dev path. Phase 3 vẫn dùng real ISG analyzer (sau khi có scan data). (4) Sub-skill paths cache 24h: scripts/wf-fix-bugs/phase1-validate-paths.sh — cache hit ~10ms thay vì 13 test -f syscalls mỗi lần. Cache key: md5(script_path + sub_skills_list), location: ~/.cache/mcv3-fix-bugs/skill-paths-{md5}.json. TTL configurable qua MCV3_FIX_BUGS_PATH_CACHE_TTL. Số bash tool calls Phase 1: ~10 → ~7 (-30%), mỗi call giảm thêm ~500ms-1s Claude orchestration latency. Pure execution time giảm ~500-900ms. Tổng giảm Claude orchestration ~5-10s trên Phase 1 ~30s baseline. Non-breaking: tất cả helpers độc lập, không thay đổi output paths/contracts với phase downstream. Existing init-session-state.sh + init-bug-dashboard.sh vẫn hoạt động (workers bên trong bundle). Backward compat: nếu helpers mới fail → individual steps cũ vẫn dùng được (fallback path). Dependency Chain mới: 6 nhóm thực thi (Bootstrap → Wave 1 parallel → Wave 2 sequential → Session Setup → ISG fast-path → Wave 4 parallel → Finalize) thay vì 18 steps tuần tự.

resume_routing.description: --resume & --status handlers trong procedures/resume-status.md. --status: 7 steps display phase table + CI status + metrics + next action. --resume: 10 steps find session → read status → stale check → lock → route to phase.

E001.description: POST-GATE fail sau 3 retries — DỪNG phase, escalate. Triggered bởi mọi POST-GATE T1-T4 không pass.

E002.description: User từ chối tiếp tục (CDG reject) — Checkpoint, thông báo --resume.

E003.description: Registry thiếu/rỗng — STOP. User cần chạy /wf-brainstorm hoặc /existing-project trước.

E004.description: Sub-skill SKILL.md không tồn tại. Dừng workflow.

E005.description: N=0 issues sau Phase 4 — Hệ thống healthy, skip Phase 5-6 → jump Phase 7. Early-exit guard.

E008.description: Stale lock detected (≥30 min) — auto-release, WARN, continue.

E009.description: Context > 90% — FORCE checkpoint, dùng --resume để tiếp tục.

E010.description: Phase 1: `--status` dispatched — Hiển thị status → STOP. Canonical SSOT: _shared.md §4.

E011.description: Phase 1: `--resume` dispatched — Enter resume path (resume-status.md §--resume Handler). Canonical SSOT: _shared.md §4.

E013.description: Phase 1: Deprecation block (legacy v6.x paths) — CDG render, escape hatch `MCV3_FIX_BUGS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED_OK=1`. Exit 78 (E_LEGACY_BLOCK).

E014.description: Phase 1: CI detection fail — Graceful degrade → Grep/Glob fallback, pipeline tiếp tục.

E015.description: Phase 1: CI tools unavailable + non-git project — Skip CI, dùng Grep/Glob fallback.

E016.description: Phase 1: CI index severely stale (>50 commits behind HEAD) — WARN mạnh, continue với Grep/Glob fallback.

E019.description: Phase 1: Lock acquire fail hoặc heartbeat daemon fail — STOP nếu process khác active; WARN + continue không heartbeat nếu heartbeat fail (risky).

E020.description: Phase 2: Code scan fail — không parse được source code structure.

E021.description: Phase 2: Interface type ambiguous — không xác định được web/mobile/api-only.

E030.description: Phase 3: ISG Recommender fail — không đề xuất được dimensions. Cross-phase: Phase 4 PRE-GATE cũng emit E030 khi phát hiện Phase 3 chưa completed.

E031.description: Phase 3: Partition planner fail — không tạo được workloads. Auto-generate fallback.

E035.description: Phase 3/4: Atomic write / mkdir / template not found fail. Phase 3 dùng cho Workload Gate blocked (>1.5); Phase 4 dùng cho lane dir create + lane-status.json write + Step 4.6 atomic mv.

E040.description: Phase 4: Lane dispatch fail — agent spawn error. Retry per-agent x1.

E041.description: Phase 4: Probe timeout — probe vượt WF_FIX_PROBE_MAX_RUNTIME_SEC. Ghi probe-failures.log.

E042.description: Phase 4: Playwright crash — browser process died. Retry x1, fallback skip lane.

E043.description: Phase 4: Agent report missing sau spawn — generate stub, WARN.

E044.description: Phase 4: Playwright launch fail — Retry x2, escalate nếu vẫn fail.

E045.description: Phase 4: Mobile coverage incomplete — thiếu device test results.

E046.description: Phase 4: Agent spawn/template render fail (lane-agent-prompt corruption / lane timeout >15min). Re-render từ template, KHÔNG sửa tay; mark lane failed nếu retry vẫn fail.

E047.description: Phase 4: DATA INCONSISTENCY — claimed signal count ≠ actual files. Retry fix x1, escalate AskUserQuestion nếu vẫn fail.

E048.description: Phase 4: Signal schema validation fail — required field thiếu. Drop signal, log warning, tiếp tục.

E049.description: Phase 4: Fingerprint collision — duplicate signals. Keep first, skip duplicate, không block.

E050.description: Phase 5: Aggregator fail — signal aggregation error. Retry x3.

E051.description: Phase 5: Step verification fail — artifact check không pass. CDG render.

E052.description: Phase 5: Process violation detected (PI1-PI5) — evaluate severity, CDG render if critical.

E053.description: Phase 5: Triage spawn fail — wf-fix-triage agent error. Re-spawn x1.

E054.description: Phase 5: CDG Rejected Critical — Anti-loop guard (max 2 reject, đồng nhất với E055/E071), escalate.

E055.description: Phase 5: Safety Check blockers — CDG render, reject 2 lần → ESCALATE.

E060.description: Phase 6: Execute spawn fail — wf-fix-execute agent error. Re-spawn x1.

E061.description: Phase 6: Fix report missing/broken — Retry generate từ template.

E070.description: Phase 7: CQG-1 numeric mismatch — fix-plan vs fix-report metrics differ >5%. Retry x3.

E071.description: Phase 7: CQG-2 browser/integration fail — evidence missing. CDG render, max 2 reject.

E073.description: Phase 7: Dashboard/summary generation fail. Retry x1.

E074.description: Phase 7: fix-impact.json / phase-summary / report generation fail. Retry x1.

E075.description: Phase 7: Atomic write / trace failure. Retry x1.

E090b.description: CDG: Parallel BASE_URL conflict (v10.2) — peer session đang test cùng BASE_URL. AskUserQuestion 3 options: Đợi peer xong / Tiếp tục (chắc chắn isolated) / Hủy session. Bypass cho CI/CD: MCV3_PW_ALLOW_SHARED_URL=1. Trigger bởi wf-fix-baseurl-conflict-check.sh ở Phase 4 Step 4.3 (v10.3 just-in-time CDG, moved from Phase 1).

E091.description: CDG: Scope recommendation — ISG suggests narrower scope than requested.

E092.description: CDG: Cost estimate exceeds budget — LLM scan cost > $1.50 cap.

E093.description: CDG: Mobile recommendation — interface type supports mobile but --mobile not set.

E100.description: CDG: QD9/QD10/QD11 recommendation — dimension not in plan but applicable.

EDLG.description: Sub-skill delegation incomplete — LOG error, FAIL trace.
